title: Weekly Elevation Gain Drop-Off
dataSources: Strava API activities (`strava:activity`), Garmin Connect (`garmin:activity`), Fitbit Web API (`fitbit:activity`), Peloton workout history (`peloton:workout`), Zwift ride exports (`zwift:activity`).
app: Strava / Garmin Connect / Fitbit / Peloton / Zwift APIs and webhooks via Splunk HEC scripted inputs; GPX/FIT/CSV activity exports ingested as file inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=strava:activity
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(elevation_gain_m) as climb_m by athlete _time
| streamstats window=4 current=f avg(climb_m) as baseline by athlete
| eval pct_of_baseline=round(100*climb_m/baseline,1)
| where baseline>0 AND pct_of_baseline<60
| sort pct_of_baseline
description: Compares weekly climbing volume to your rolling baseline and spots flat weeks that can quietly erode hill strength before race day arrives.
value: If you live for hilly races or rides, elevation matters as much as distance; a drop-off alert preserves the specificity your plan needs.
implementation: Ingest total elevation gain per activity; schedule weekly and review any week that falls far below your recent climbing baseline.
visualization: Line chart of weekly elevation gain versus four-week baseline.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces when your usual amount of climbing drops a lot and your hill fitness starts slipping.
